text: Ɓe waɗi ko ɓen maɓɓe yamiri ɓe kon, ɓe yehi ɗaɓɓitugol Yuusufa e miñan-mun. Nde ɓe naatunoo ka Yuusufa, ɓe wi'ani mo: Tammpere e baasal heɓii men. Men ardii e sil'a jaasuɗo fanɗuɗo. Etan-men ko timmi, wano etiranayno-ɗaa men aranun, sakko-ɗaa e amen ko ɓeydii kon e ɗum maa sulfiraneede si'la amen fanɗuɗo on. Pellet, Alla yoɓitiray sakko- tooɓe ɓen ko ɓuri moƴƴude e njoɓdi.
